items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: you take Billy Taylor. Billy Taylor has done one hell of a job for modern jazz.

ctx.x: So the idea is that we must begin now, and say now, and I'm willing to be one of the creators...I've...incidentally, I've just been named as one of the members of the board of a cultural thing that we're doing here in central Harlem... they're going to spend seventy or eighty million dollars on this project and I'm on the Board of Directors. And I most certainly intend to see...and what actually happened was that Assemblyman George W. Miller called a meeting to report on this affair and the board members…

And my feelings are that we are going to have to join together and to be motivated and to do some of these things just as the...you take Billy Taylor. Billy Taylor has done one hell of a job for modern jazz. He's been in on all of the committees,

you know what I mean, he's been where the, you know, where the money's allocated and appropriated and where the plans are formulated...he's been in on all of that. So as a result of that, his Jazzmobile has been a success.
